model.name: viewPipeline.revalidateOrMarkStale
model.description: The live client subscribes to the ws UNIT_CHANGED and on notify / focus / visibilitychange REVALIDATES the affected subtree (re-fetch + compare rendered.hash vs current.hash) OR marks it VISIBLY STALE (a badge). Unconfirmed currency == STALE, never fresh (fail-closed, same shape as NOT-RUN==RED); the (re)connect welcome piggybacks the current revision for reconcile. This is how never-return-a-silently-drifted-value reaches the RENDER surface (fixes the pin-swap-not-appearing Tron feels).
